task.title: Adding a Display Capture Source
task.shortdesc: Capture an entire monitor as a source.

context.p: Display Capture mirrors an entire monitor, including anything that appears on top of other windows, such as notifications or cursor tooltips.

step.cmd: In the Sources panel, click the + button and choose Display Capture.
Name the source and click OK.
Choose which monitor to capture from the Display dropdown.

step.info: Turn this off if you plan to add a separate, styled cursor overlay later.

taskbody.result: The selected monitor appears in the current scene and updates live.
